svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Microservices on Azure Container Apps
svg.desc: Microservices on Azure Container Apps. 14 components in 3 groups. Connections: Client apps to Ingestion service (HTTPS); Azure Service Bus to Ingestion service (enqueue); Azure Service Bus to Workflow service; Workflow service to Package service; Workflow service to Drone scheduler service; Workflow service to Delivery service; Package service to Azure DocumentDB; Drone scheduler service to Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL; Delivery service to Azure Managed Redis; Drone scheduler service to Key Vault; Delivery service to Key Vault; Application Insights to Container Apps environment; Log Analytics workspace to Container Apps environment; Container Registry to Container Apps environment (pull images).

text.tspan: The ingestion service queues delivery requests in Service Bus; the workflow service dispatches them to three services, each with its own data store
